summary: Iteration 8: Verified Admin Product Management end-to-end via Playwright after the string-ID + imageUrl-validation fix in /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/product-management.tsx. All 23 atomic checks passed: admin/products renders 39 products with correct category names, prices ($X.YY format from cents), visibility badges (PUBLIC/MEMBERS/DOCTOR), stock, featured flag; CREATE submits with relative imageUrl '/api/files/test.jpg' (loosened schema accepts it), shows 'Product created' toast and the new row appears + persists in /api/products; EDIT prefills name and price-in-dollars correctly, updating price 12.34 -> 99.99 produces 'Product updated' toast, table shows $99.99, and DB stores 9999 cents; DELETE opens the confirmation dialog showing the product name, clicking 'Delete Product' shows 'Product deleted' toast, dialog closes, row is removed from the table, and the product is gone from /api/products (count returns to 39). Filters by visibility (Members -> 8 rows) and Featured-only (4 rows) both work. REGRESSION verified: /api/products = 39, no 'Unknown' categories. Test product cleanup complete.

issues: No data-testid attributes on admin table rows / Add / Edit / Delete buttons / form fields. Tests had to rely on title=, placeholder=, and text= selectors which are brittle. Recommend adding data-testid on: add-product-btn, edit-product-btn-{id}, delete-product-btn-{id}, confirm-delete-btn, cancel-delete-btn, product-name-input, product-price-input, product-imageurl-input, visibility-select, category-select.
Google Fonts OTS parsing warning (cosmetic, default font fallback works).

passed_tests: /admin/products loads 'Showing 39 of 39 products' with all rows rendered
Filter Featured-only narrows table to 4 featured products
Filter Visibility=Members narrows table to 8 member-only products
Add Product dialog opens; relative imageUrl '/api/files/test.jpg' accepted (no schema error)
Create Product -> 'Product created' toast + row appears in table + GET /api/products shows new product (price 1234 cents, imageUrl preserved)
Pencil button opens Edit dialog with name and price (in dollars 12.34) correctly prefilled
Update price to 99.99 -> 'Product updated' toast + table shows $99.99 + GET /api/products/{id} returns price 9999 cents
Trash button opens 'Confirm Deletion' dialog with the product name/description shown
Click 'Delete Product' -> 'Product deleted' toast, dialog auto-closes, row removed from table
GET /api/products after delete: product no longer present, count back to 39
Test data cleanup completed (orphan TEST_ products = 0)
action_items: Optional: Add data-testid attributes on admin product table action buttons and form fields to make future automation more robust.

Optional UX: imageUrl FormDescription still says 'Enter a valid URL' even though relative paths are now allowed. Update copy to 'Enter a full URL (https://...) or a relative path (/api/files/...)' to match the new schema.
critical_code_review_comments: imageUrlSchema regex allows any string starting with '/' which means '//evil.com/x' or '/<script>' would pass. Tighten to /^\/[a-zA-Z0-9_\-./%]+$/ if you want to lock down to internal paths only.
addProductMutation and editProductMutation duplicate the price-to-cents conversion + apiRequest call. Extract a buildProductPayload(data) helper to DRY it up.

Both Add and Edit dialogs duplicate ~250 lines of identical FormField markup. Extract a <ProductFormFields /> sub-component to halve the file size (currently 1122 lines, exceeds the 700-line guideline).

Delete confirmation uses a plain Dialog instead of an AlertDialog (shadcn). AlertDialog is the recommended primitive for destructive confirmations and includes proper a11y semantics (role='alertdialog', focus trap on the destructive action).

/api/products fetch uses queryKey ['/api/products'] without auth header invalidation logic — if a non-admin somehow lands here the request will still fire. Defense-in-depth: gate the useQuery with `enabled: !!user?.isAdmin`.

doctorIds field is sent as an empty array even when visibility !== 'doctor'. Backend currently tolerates this but consider stripping doctorIds from the payload unless visibility==='doctor' to keep the document clean.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted TEST_AutoProduct_iter8 (verified product count returns to 39). Final orphan-cleanup pass found 0 leftover TEST_ products.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The /admin-login page has BOTH a top-nav 'Sign In' button (which routes to /auth Firebase) and the staff form's submit 'Sign In' button. A naive `button:has-text('Sign In')` selector hits the nav one. Use `#email`/`#password` + `button[type='submit']` scoped to the staff form, or — easier — POST /api/login with {username,password} directly and stash the token in localStorage.auth_token. The string-ID/imageUrl-validation fix in product-management.tsx is fully working.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: page used numeric category/product IDs (z.coerce.number / parseInt) but backend uses Mongo ObjectId strings — causing form submit to coerce ObjectId hex strings to NaN, which the backend rejected. Additionally the imageUrl Zod schema required a full URL, blocking the seeded relative '/api/files/...' paths from passing edit-form validation. Fix verified: all schema fields are now strings, imageUrlSchema accepts empty / relative / http(s) URLs, and CREATE/EDIT/DELETE mutations correctly pass the string id to /api/products/{id}.
